title: Zero Labs Overview
content: Zero Labs is an open-source developer tools organization building high-quality libraries, templates, and agentic toolkits to help teams ship reliable software faster. Projects are MIT/AGPL licensed and community-driven.

title: Zero Labs 概览
content: Zero Labs 是一个开源开发工具组织，提供高质量的库、模板与智能体工具包，帮助团队更快、更可靠地交付软件。项目采用 MIT/AGPL 开源协议，由社区共同驱动。

title: What is Zero Buddy
content: Zero Buddy is an AI chat assistant by Zero Labs, built with a Rust (Axum) backend and a Next.js frontend. It supports Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), FAQ-first answering, answer caching, and offline knowledge display. It can be embedded into any website as a support or docs assistant.

title: 什么是 Zero Buddy
content: Zero Buddy 是 Zero Labs 旗下的一个 AI 聊天助手项目，基于 Rust 后端与 Next.js 前端构建。它支持检索增强生成（RAG）、FAQ 优先应答、答案缓存与离线知识库展示，可嵌入网站作为客服/文档助手。

title: Zero Buddy Architecture
content: The backend uses Rust + Axum and exposes a POST /api/chat endpoint that integrates LLM calls, knowledge-base retrieval (RAG), FAQ, and answer caching. The frontend is a Next.js + TypeScript chat widget embeddable in any page. Configuration is injected via environment variables: LLM_API_KEY, BIND_ADDR, CORS_ORIGIN, NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL.

title: Zero Buddy 技术架构
content: 后端采用 Rust + Axum 框架，提供 /api/chat 接口，集成 LLM 调用、知识库检索（RAG）、FAQ 与答案缓存；前端为 Next.js + TypeScript 聊天组件，可一键嵌入任意页面。配置通过环境变量（如 LLM_API_KEY、BIND_ADDR、CORS_ORIGIN、NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL）注入。

title: Zero Buddy Offline Mode
content: When LLM_API_KEY is not set, Zero Buddy automatically enters OFFLINE mode: it stops calling the LLM and skips embedding-based cache writes, returning FAQ answers and raw knowledge-base snippets directly. This keeps basic Q&A and contact info working even without AI quota.

title: 离线模式说明
content: 当未配置 LLM_API_KEY 时，Zero Buddy 自动进入离线模式：不再调用 LLM，也跳过缓存写入中的向量计算，而是直接返回 FAQ 与知识库检索到的原文片段。这保证在没有 AI 额度的情况下，基础问答与联系方式仍能正常服务。

title: Zero Buddy Deployment
content: The backend listens on 127.0.0.1:3030 by default. For production, put it behind Nginx/Caddy reverse proxy on 80/443 with HTTPS. Set BIND_ADDR to 0.0.0.0 to expose directly (configure firewall) or keep 127.0.0.1 and let the proxy forward. Set CORS_ORIGIN to your frontend domain to allow cross-origin requests.

title: 部署指南
content: 后端默认监听 127.0.0.1:3030，生产环境建议配合 Nginx/Caddy 反向代理到 80/443 端口并提供 HTTPS。环境变量 BIND_ADDR 可设为 0.0.0.0 直接暴露（需自行做好防火墙），或保留 127.0.0.1 由反代转发。CORS_ORIGIN 需设置为前端域名以允许跨域。

title: Zero Buddy API
content: Main endpoint: POST /api/chat. Request body: {"query": "your question"}. Response envelope: {"code":0,"message":"ok","body":{"reply":"answer text","source":"faq|cache|offline|llm","url":"optional link"}}. The source field indicates where the answer came from.

title: API 接口
content: 主要接口为 POST /api/chat，请求体为 JSON：{"query": "你的问题"}。响应为统一信封：{"code":0,"message":"ok","body":{"reply":"回答内容","source":"faq|cache|offline|llm","url":"可选的链接"}}。source 字段标明答案来源。
